Although the doctors and medical services at Bath Street Medical Centre are genuinely great, the administration and reception team are the sorry pitfall of this practice.

On two separate occasions, reception staff have hung up mid-call — an unacceptable level of service in any setting, let alone a medical one. They seem either unwilling or unable to carry out their responsibilities to even a basic standard, let alone go above and beyond. If you’re unhappy or incapable of handling the duties of your role, perhaps it’s time to find another line of work.

Time and time again, communications sent by the admin team are either riddled with spelling errors, grammatical mistakes, or outright misinformation. The most recent example was a text message stating that the surgery will close on “Monday 7th November 2025” — a date that doesn’t even exist!

It is concerning that despite the transition to new merger with Cosely Medical Centre, the same administrative failings remain entrenched. The practice’s reputation and smooth operation depend heavily on the competence of its frontline staff. Unless there is a thorough review, retraining, or replacement of the current admin team (with the exception of one capable individual), the practice will continue to fail its patients. The admin staff desperately need retraining or replacing. It’s a sad and sorry state of affairs that such an excellent team of doctors is being let down by such poor administrative
